Class.Description: Created using the page template: Default

Parameter.name: APPLICATION
Parameter.Description: Class name of application this page belongs to.

XData.name: Style
XData.Description: This Style block contains page-specific CSS style definitions.
XData.Data:
<style type="text/css">
 body { font-family: arial; }

     table.tpTable caption{
       background: transparent;
       font-size: 1.4em;
       font-weight: bold;
       text-align: left;
       border: none;
     }

    /* even rows */
     .tpEven { color: black; background: #ebf3ff; }
    
    /* odd rows */
     .tpOdd { color: black; background: white; }

    /* this is a selected row */
     table.tpTable tr.tpSelected { background: #3d80df; color: white; }
   
    /* hover for odd and even rows */
     tr.tpOdd:hover,tr.tpEven:hover { 
        background-color: #3d80df; 
        color: #ffffff; }
  
    /* table header style */
    table.tpTable th {
        border-right: 1px solid gray;
        border-bottom: 1px solid gray;
        background: #C5D6D6;
        color: black;
        font-weight: bold;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 2px;
        overflow: hidden;
     }

    /* selected column header (th) */
     table.tpTable th.tpHdrSelected { background: #3d80df; }

    /* filter layout */
     table.tpFilterLayout td { border: none; background: #C5D6D6; }

/*fieldSet styles*/
.fieldset{
     background: #FFFFFF;
     border: solid 5px #C5D6D6;
     color: #000000;
     font-size: 1em;
     font-family: arial;
}
/*text control styles*/
.text
{  
    font-size: .8em;
    font-family: arial;
    color: #000000;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    padding: 2px;
    border: solid 1px grey;
    margin-right: 0px;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
    height: 25px;
}
/*dataCombo styles*/
.comboboxInput  {
    font-size: .8em;
    font-family: arial;
    color: #000000;  
    padding: 2px;
    border: solid 1px grey;
    margin-right: 0px;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
    height: 20px;
 }         


</style>

XData.name: Contents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this page.
XData.Data:
<page xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" title="Source Control Management">
<hgroup align="left" valign="top" > <!-- LOGO --> <vgroup align="center" valign="top" > <vgroup width="100%" align="left">
<image id="logo"/> <spacer width="20"/> <label label="Interface Team" align="center" /> <spacer width="20"/> </vgroup>
</vgroup> <spacer width="20"/> <!-- REFRESH --> <vgroup align="center" valign="top" > <hgroup width="100%" align="center" label="Source Control Information"> <spacer width="20"/> <button caption="Refresh" align="center" onclick="zenPage.refreshSrcCtrlInfo();" /> <spacer width="20"/> </hgroup>
</vgroup> <spacer width="20"/> <!-- PASSWORD --> <vgroup valign="top">
<hgroup width="100%" align="center" label="LDAP Password"> <spacer width="20"/> <password id="psw" name="passwd" required="true" /> <spacer width="20"/> </hgroup>
</vgroup> <spacer width="20"/> <!-- CHECKOUT --> <vgroup valign="top" width="50%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlOutFieldSet" hidden="false" legend="Get File"> <form id="srcCtrlOutForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;"> <text label="Revision:" id="Revision" name="Revision" required="false" size="10"/> </form>
<hgroup align="center">
<button caption="CheckOut" onclick="zenPage.GetFromSrcCtrl();" />
</hgroup> </fieldSet>
</vgroup> <spacer width="20"/> <!-- INFORMATION --> <vgroup valign="top" width="50%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInfoFieldSet" hidden="false" legend=" File ">
<hgroup align="center">
<button caption="Infomation" onclick="zenPage.GetSrcCtrlInfo();" />
</hgroup> </fieldSet>
</vgroup> <spacer width="20"/> <!-- CHECKIN --> <vgroup valign="top" width="50%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInFieldSet" hidden="false" legend=" Checkin "> <form id="srcCtrlInForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;"> <text label="Comment:" id="Comment" name="Comment" required="true" size="100"/> </form>
<hgroup align="center"> <button caption="CheckIn" onclick="zenPage.saveSrcCtrl();" />
</hgroup> </fieldSet>
</vgroup>
</hgroup> <!-- table of FILES --> <hgroup width="100%"> <vgroup width="100%"> <hgroup> <tablePane width="80%" tableName="ITFCOMMON.SrcCtrlInfo" id="srcCtrlTable" maxRows="200" pageSize="200" showRowNumbers="true" showZebra="true" useSnapshot="true" extraColumnWidth="5%" caption="Files" showRowSelector ="false" multiSelect="true" valueColumn="FileName"> <column colName="ID" hidden="true"/> <column header="FileName" width="40%" colName="FileName"/> <column header="Internal Time" width="15%" colName="ClassModifiedTime"/> <column header="Checkin Time" width="15%" colName="FileModifiedTime" OnDrawCell="DrawTime"/> <column header="Comment" width="10%" colName="Comment" hidden="true"/> </tablePane> <spacer width=".5"/>
</hgroup>
</vgroup> </hgroup>
<!-- SVN INFO and LOG INFORMATION about FILE --> <vgroup id="svnInfoGroup" width="50%" hidden="true" label="File checkin Information">
<html id="svnContent" width="100%" /> <spacer width="10" /> <button caption="Close" onclick="zenPage.closeSrcCtrlInfo();" />
</vgroup>
</page>
